question: Within the already burned REveL Dynamic LITE R2 Development evidence, are wrong-signed parent-event radial-flow errors descriptively dominated by ego motion, by within-event temporal measurement noise, or not identifiable by the available single-capture evidence?
non_goals: change or rerun either LITE R2 arm
select a threshold, window or module on REveL
produce a new effectiveness, generalization, safety or product conclusion
treat frames, frame pairs or tracks as independent samples
run a population p-value or infer a population effect
open or derive the old F-1B decision output
download or execute EVIMO2v2, JRDB or a Confirmation source

data_role.region_rule: Use the frozen parent event anchor_region. A region change does not split a parent event.

forbidden_inputs: old F-1B decision output or any derivative
R0 or R1 failed candidate output as scientific evidence
new REveL clips, events, labels or identities

continuity.rgb_to_person_pair: strict source person-pose bracket around each bag image timestamp

source_motion_derivation.finite_difference_radial_definition: For each frozen person-pose pair, r0 and r1 are person-marker minus synchronized sensor-marker world positions at the two endpoints. Define g=(r0+r1)/(norm(r0)+norm(r1)); this chord range gradient satisfies dot(g,r1-r0)=norm(r1)-norm(r0) exactly apart from floating-point representation.

range_rate_components.pair_time_basis: Use the frozen person-pose endpoint timestamps and the same nearest sensor indices used by the predecessor truth. v_person_world=(person1-person0)/dt and v_sensor_marker_world=(sensor_at_nearest1-sensor_at_nearest0)/dt on that same dt.
range_rate_components.sensor_absolute_share: At pair level, abs(sensor_approach_component_mps) divided by the sum of the absolute person and sensor approach components; rows with a denominator below 1e-6 m/s are null and remain counted for support. At event level, use the median of finite pair-level shares, requiring at least 3 finite shares and finite-share coverage at least 0.50 over the frozen event pair denominator; otherwise the event share is null and remains counted.
range_rate_components.closure_check: The recomputed signed approach must match the frozen truth sign and rate within 1e-6 m/s on common valid rows; otherwise execution is invalid and no scientific exit is emitted.

camera_rig_motion.camera_pose: world_T_camera = world_T_sensor_marker multiplied by frozen T_v_c from calibration.yaml
translation: camera optical-center translation speed in m/s
camera optical-center radial approach component relative to each target in m/s
camera_rig_motion.angular_velocity: Shortest-arc quaternion log divided by delta-t, expressed in camera coordinates as xyz rad/s and magnitude rad/s.
camera_rig_motion.truth_boundary: Camera optical-center motion is diagnostic only. It does not rewrite the existing sensor-marker-to-person Development truth.

event_level_diagnostic_table.classification_binding: Join the exact frozen R2 evaluation event rows by arm_id and event_id. Reuse its 0.02/s deadband, predicted_state, correct and wrong_signed fields without D0 reclassification.
event_level_diagnostic_table.aggregation: Use medians, MAD, IQR, P90, counts and fixed-denominator fractions as named. Do not average frames across events as if independent.
event_level_diagnostic_table.source_component_event_support: A source component event summary requires at least 3 finite source pairs and finite-pair coverage at least 0.50 over the frozen event denominator. Otherwise the component fields are null, the event remains in all counts, and a comparison cell may become not evaluable.
event_level_diagnostic_table.flow_sign_flip_definition: Map each finite flow signed rate through the frozen 0.02/s deadband to -1, 0 or +1. Use only consecutive adjacent rows in the original frozen parent-event order when both endpoints are finite; an abstained or nonfinite row breaks the chain and no transition may bridge across it. Divide changing eligible transitions by all eligible transitions; zero eligible transitions yields null.

descriptive_comparison.primary_contrast: WRONG_SIGNED versus CORRECT parent events for ROI_SPARSE_RADIAL_FLOW
secondary_contrasts: the same fixed summaries for BBOX_LOG_AREA_GROWTH
reported_statistics: direction consistency by target and anchor region
descriptive_comparison.cliff_delta_definition: P(burden_WRONG_SIGNED > burden_CORRECT) minus P(burden_WRONG_SIGNED < burden_CORRECT), with ties contributing zero.

burden_orientation.surviving_tracks_occupied_quadrants_and_: multiply by -1 so lower support is higher burden
burden_orientation.event_duration: use negative natural log of duration_s so shorter events are higher burden

material_fixed_capture_shift.rationale: A preregistered moderate descriptive separation floor; it is not a significance test and has no population interpretation.

ego_core_supported_when: The WRONG_SIGNED event median sensor_absolute_share is greater than 0.5.
At least one ego_core metric has burden-oriented Cliff delta at least 0.33 in the fixed capture.

That metric is evaluable and has positive burden direction in both target marginals and in at least two anchor-region marginals; it must separately have Cliff delta at least 0.33 in both approaching and receding truth-state marginals.
Every other evaluable anchor-region marginal is checked; any material opposite shift with Cliff delta at most -0.33 makes the fixed capture internally contradictory.
The person competing explanation does not show an equal-or-larger material shift with the same target and region consistency.
temporal_core_supported_when: At least one direct_temporal_instability metric and at least one support_or_persistence_burden metric each have burden-oriented Cliff delta at least 0.33 in the fixed capture.

Each required metric is evaluable and has positive burden direction in both target marginals and in at least two anchor-region marginals; each must separately have Cliff delta at least 0.33 in both approaching and receding truth-state marginals.
Every other evaluable anchor-region marginal is checked; any material opposite shift with Cliff delta at most -0.33 makes the fixed capture internally contradictory.
Multiple support metrics without a direct temporal-instability metric cannot establish temporal dominance.
composition_and_contradiction_guard: Report the CORRECT, WRONG_SIGNED and OTHER_INCORRECT truth-state counts and fixed-denominator fractions.

The primary WRONG_SIGNED versus CORRECT route must be separately evaluable in both approaching and receding truth states; quasi-static has no wrong-signed category and remains a secondary OTHER_INCORRECT diagnostic.

For every metric used to support a route, both approaching and receding marginals must be evaluable and each must have burden-oriented Cliff delta at least 0.33. A smaller or opposite state-specific shift, or a pooled shift produced only by different mixture weights, routes to MECHANISM_NOT_IDENTIFIABLE.

Both target marginals and at least two anchor-region marginals must meet the comparison cell minimum. Only a region below the cell minimum may be omitted from positive consistency; no evaluable material opposite region may be ignored.
Target-by-region cells are reported diagnostics and cannot rescue a failed marginal guard.

route.MECHANISM_NOT_IDENTIFIABLE: both cores supported, neither core supported, person motion is an equal competing explanation, the truth-state composition guard fails, there are not enough evaluable cells to assess both targets and at least two anchor regions, or the fixed single capture is internally contradictory

EGO_MOTION_DOMINANT.mechanism_change: Estimate one robust background affine transform from pixels/features outside the target mask or ROI, then compute target-internal residual radial expansion.
excluded_parallel_changes: homography alternative in the same canary
EGO_MOTION_DOMINANT.acquisition_boundary: The official flea3_7 motion-segmentation NPZ is approximately 33 GB. Do not download the approximately 525 GB full NPZ dataset for this canary.

future_data_order.condition: D0 scientific exit is EGO_MOTION_DOMINANT and a new canary contract is independently frozen before outcome access.
future_data_order.source_facts: The official motion-segmentation set provides independently moving objects, pixelwise masks, depth maps and trajectories; the flea3_7 NPZ is listed as 33 GB.

future_data_order.condition: The single EVIMO2v2 compensation canary passes its prospectively frozen mechanism gate.
future_data_order.source_facts: The official page lists 54 indoor/outdoor sequences, 360-degree RGB plus LiDAR, 2D and 3D person boxes, and stationary and moving sensor perspectives.

future_data_order.condition: A final candidate is frozen without using this source for selection or tuning.
future_data_order.source_facts: REveL cannot fill this role because it is already burned single-capture Development evidence.

revel_limit.source_facts: The official page describes 14.1 minutes over four ROS bags, a handheld moving sensor suite in a Vicon volume, and two motion-captured people.
revel_limit.current_local_role: The D0 input is the already burned REVEL_DYNAMIC_V1 single capture with two helmet-marker targets.
